tex_content.html:
Lemma
[A minimizing polygon is smooth] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0327 ↗ appb-lem-polygon-space-compact 1. Lemma B.69\group comparison-theorems

If $\beta \in \Lambda $ minimizes total length, then $\beta $ is a smooth geodesic loop.

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0327, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0328 \sketch If a minimizing polygon were not smooth at a vertex, a one-parameter shortening deformation would have negative first variation, contradicting minimality.

□
